title: Omnium and Carhartt WIP Collaborate on a  Stainless Steel Mini Max
content:
Danish cargo bike innovators Omnium recently developed a stainless steel chassis version of its popular Mini Max with workwear brand Carhartt WIP. To keep its raw appearance, the frame is clear-coated with Carhartt WIP decals, leaving high-quality welds and heat discoloration visible. The bike is available in three sizes (S/M/L) and is limited to 150 units only; global shipping is available, but at freight rates.

Other notes on this stunning collaboration are acid yellow and black co-branded graphics, DT Swiss cargo wheels, cargo webbing, lock-on foam grips, and a titanium-railed saddle. Our favorite detail is the custom-engraved and inlay-painted MKS Beartrap pedals, which are available separately from the complete bike.

Check out the full collaboration at Omnium.
